id: 第二章-善恶篇-南京的基督-一-p1

en: 第二章-善恶篇-南京的基督-一
It was a late night in autumn.
u.src: 秋日，深夜。

en: In a house on Qiwang Street in Nanjing, a Chinese girl was sitting beside a plain, old table,
u.src: 在南京奇望街的一栋房子里，有一个中国少女正坐在简陋老旧的桌子旁边，

en: her face pale, her cheek propped in her hand, idly cracking the melon seeds on the plate.
u.src: 她面色苍白，以手托腮，无聊的磕着盘子里瓜子。

en: There was an oil lamp on the table, its light dim and murky.
u.src: 桌子上有一盏油灯，灯光昏暗。

en: This light not only failed to brighten the room, but made the room feel even more gloomy.
u.src: 这灯光不仅没有照亮屋子，而且给屋子里更营造了一种阴郁的氛围。

en: The wallpaper in the room already showed signs of peeling; a dust-covered curtain hung down from the wicker bed in the corner, and one corner of the blanket drooped as well.
u.src: 屋子里的壁纸已经有剥落的迹象了，布满灰尘的帐子从屋角的藤床上垂了下来，毛毯的一角也耷拉下来。

en: Opposite the table was another chair, just as plain and old, left unused to one side as if it had been forgotten.
u.src: 桌子对面也是一把同样简陋老旧的椅子，像是被忘记一样的闲置在一旁。

en: Apart from these things, there were no other furnishings in the room.
u.src: 除了这些东西，屋里在没有其他摆设了。

en: The girl paid no attention to any of this; from time to time she stopped cracking melon seeds, lifted her shining eyes, and stared dreamily at the wall across the table.
u.src: 少女对这些事情毫不在意，她时不时的停下嗑瓜子的动作，抬起闪亮的双眼，望着桌子对面的墙壁出神。

ja: がきちんとかかっていた。
en: On the wall there was a bent hook, and from it hung a small brass cross, set very straight.
u.src: 墙壁上面有一枚弯钩，弯钩上挂着一个十字架，黄铜材质，小小的，挂的十分端正。

en: On the cross was a figure of Christ with both arms stretched high; the workmanship looked somewhat crude, and the worn relief hovered faintly before her eyes like a shadow.
u.src: 十字架上，是高高伸展开双臂的基督像，雕像做工显得有些简陋，被磨损的浮雕像影子一般隐隐约约的浮现在她眼前。

en: Whenever she looked at the image of Jesus, the lonely darkness in the girl's eyes would vanish, and the expression beneath her long eyelashes would fill with innocent hope.
u.src: 每次看到耶稣像的时候，少女眼中的寂寞深色便会一扫而空，长长的睫毛下的神色也变得充满天真的希望。

en: But whenever her gaze left the image of Jesus, the girl would let out a long sigh; the black satin clothes she wore were old and dull, and her shoulders drooped weakly in dejection,
u.src: 但是，每次眼神离开耶稣像的时候，少女都会长叹一声，她身上的黑色缎子衣服老旧无光，肩膀消极无力的低垂，

en: and then she went on cracking the melon seeds in the dish, one by one.
u.src: 又接着一颗一颗的磕起盘子里的瓜子来。

en: This young girl was named Song Jinhua. She had just turned fifteen, and she was a hidden prostitute who had no choice but to receive clients in her room every night in order to make a living.
u.src: 这名少女名字叫做宋金花，刚满15岁，是个见不得人的妓女，为了生计，不得不夜夜在房里接客。

en: There were many prostitutes along the Qinhuai River, and quite a few of them were as pretty as Jinhua.
u.src: 秦淮河妓女诸多，像金花这等姿色的也不在少数。

en: But it was not at all certain that one could find another girl as gentle in temperament as Jinhua.
u.src: 但是，像金花这种性格温顺的少女，却不一定能找出来第二个。

en: She was very different from the other prostitutes of her age. She did not lie or act willfully, and every night she could smile as she played merrily with the clients who came to her little room.
u.src: 她和同辈的那些妓女大不相同，不说瞎话也不任性而行，每个夜晚她都能面带笑容，陪来小屋的客人们开心的嬉闹。

en: Sometimes a client would give her a little extra money, and she would happily buy one more cup of wine for her aging father, who loved to drink.
u.src: 有时候，客人会多给一点钱，她就会开心的给年迈却好酒的父亲多来一杯。

ja: まれつきのものだった。
en: Of course, this disposition of Jinhua's was something she had been born with.
u.src: 当然了，金花的这种性情是生来就有的。

ja: ローマ・カトリックを
en: If one were to speak of any other external influence, then, as the cross on the wall showed, she had come to believe in Roman Catholicism under the influence of her late mother when she was young.
u.src: 如果要是说还有什么外因的话，就像墙壁十字架上展示的那样，她幼年的时候，就在已故母亲的影响下信仰了罗马天主教。

en: First, in the spring of this year, a young traveler from Japan was going to Shanghai to watch the horse races and take in the beautiful mountains and rivers of southern China.
u.src: 先说说今年春天，有个来自日本的年轻旅行家要去上海看赛马，领略中国南方的大好河山。

en: Driven by curiosity, this man spent a night in Jinhua's room.
u.src: 在好奇心的驱使下，这个人在金花房中度过了一个夜晚。

en: At that moment, with a cigarette in his mouth, he was holding the petite Jinhua on his Western-dressed lap,
u.src: 那个时候，他嘴里叼着香烟，把娇小的金花抱在穿着洋装的膝盖上，

en: but suddenly he saw the cross on the wall and, without meaning to, showed a puzzled expression.
u.src: 却突然看到了墙上的十字架，不由自主的露出了不解的表情。
“你信仰耶稣？”
他用不熟练的汉语问。

en: Yes, I was baptized when I was five.
u.src: “是的，我五岁就受洗了。”

en: Then why are you still doing this line of work?
u.src: “那你怎么还做这个行业啊？”

en: At the time, the Japanese traveler’s tone was full of mockery.
u.src: 当时，这位日本旅行家的口气里充满嘲讽。

en: But Jinhua rested her head against his arm,
u.src: 但是，金花将头靠在他的胳膊上，

en: her beautiful hair, black as a crow’s wing, hanging smoothly at her side, as she smiled happily as usual and showed her small canine teeth.
u.src: 鸦翅般乌黑的秀发服帖的垂在身侧，一如往常般开心的笑着，露出小虎牙。

en: If I do not do this line of work, my elderly father and I will starve to death.
u.src: “如果不做这个行业，家里的老父亲和我就得饿死。”
“你父亲年纪很大了吗？”

en: Yes, even my back is bent now.
u.src: “是的，腰都弯了。”

en: But if you do this kind of work, you cannot enter heaven after you die, can you?
u.src: “但是——你做这个行业死了以后进不了天堂的，难道不是吗？”
“不会的。”

en: Jinhua looked at the cross, as if she had remembered something.
u.src: 金花看着十字架，像是想到了什么。

en: My Lord Christ, who lives in heaven, must surely be able to understand my suffering.
u.src: “生活在天堂的我主基督，想必是能够理解我的难处的。

en: Otherwise, Christ would be no different from the officials at the Yaojia Lane police station.
u.src: 不然，基督和姚家巷警察署的官爷一样了啊。”

en: The young Japanese traveler smiled as he slipped his hand into his suit pocket, took out a pair of jade earrings, and put them on her ears himself.
u.src: 年轻的日本旅行家一边微笑，一边把手伸进西服口袋里，摸出一对翡翠耳环亲手戴在她耳朵上。

en: I had just bought this pair of earrings and meant to take them back to Japan as a gift,
u.src: “这对耳环是我刚刚买下来的，本来想带回日本当做礼物的，

en: but now I am giving them to you, as a keepsake of tonight.
u.src: 现在送给你了，当做今夜的纪念吧。”

en: In fact, from the very first night Jinhua began taking clients, it was this belief that kept her heart calm.
u.src: 事实上，金花从第一晚开始接客的时候，就是用这种信念让自己的心保持宁静的。

en: But about a month earlier, this devout prostitute had unfortunately contracted malignant syphilis.
u.src: 但是，约莫一个月前，这个虔诚的妓女却很不幸的染上了恶性梅毒。

en: After learning the news, her younger companion Chen Shancha had her drink opium wine to ease the pain, and another companion, Mao Yingchun, gave her the mercurial pills and calomel she had left over for her to use.
u.src: 在得知这个消息之后，小姐妹陈山茶让她和鸦片酒止痛，还有小姐妹毛迎春也把她用剩下的汞兰丸和迦路米送给她使用。

en: But for some unknown reason, even though Jinhua stopped taking clients and quietly rested at home, her illness remained unchanged, with no sign of improvement.
u.src: 但是不知道为什么，即使金花不再接客，就在家安静的修养，她的病也还是老样子，看不到好转的迹象。

en: One day, Chen Shancha, a younger sworn sister, came to visit Jinhua and told her very solemnly about a method--a superstitious kind of treatment.
u.src: 有一天，小姐妹陈山茶来看望金花，特别正经的告诉了她一个办法——一个迷信的治疗办法。

en: Since a customer gave you this illness, you should pass it on to someone else.
u.src: “既然你这病是客人传染给你的，那么你把这个病再传染给别人。

en: If you do that, in two or three days at most you are sure to get better.
u.src: 这样的话，顶多两三天，你就一定能好起来的。”

en: Jinhua rested her chin on her hand, and the gloomy look on her face had not eased at all.
u.src: 金花以手托腮，脸上阴郁的神色并没有减轻。

en: Of course, Shanza's words had also left quite a stir in her heart.
u.src: 当然，山茶的话也在她心里留下了不少波澜。
“真的吗”她轻轻的说。
“嗯，当果然。

ja: しても、よくならなかった。
en: My older sister once had the same illness as you, and even after treating it for a long time, she did not get better.
u.src: 我姐姐以前也得过跟你一样的病，治了好久都不好。

en: But after she passed it on to a customer, she got well right away.
u.src: 但是传给客人之后，她就立刻好起来了。”

en: What happened to that guest afterward?
u.src: “那客人后来如何了？”

en: That's awful; I hear they have gone blind.
u.src: “挺惨的，听说瞎了。”

en: After Shancha left, Jinhua knelt alone before the cross,
u.src: 山茶走了之后，金花一个人跪在十字架前面，

en: she lifted her head and gazed at Christ suffering, nailed to the cross,
u.src: 抬头看着被钉在十字架受难的基督，

en: and prayed with all her heart:
u.src: 诚心的祷告：

en: O Christ my Lord in heaven, I do this lowly trade only to support my aged father.
u.src: “天堂的我主基督，我做这个卑贱的生意，都是为了养活年老的父亲。

ja: えにはしませんでした。
en: But my trade has defiled only me; it has not dragged anyone else into harm.
u.src: 但是我的生意只让我一个人脏污了，没有让别人受到连累。

en: For that reason, I believe that even if I die later, I will surely be able to go to heaven.
u.src: 因此我认为，即使我以后死了，也定能上天堂。

en: But now, unless I pass the disease on to my customers, I can no longer keep doing this trade.
u.src: 但是现在我要是不把病传染给客人，我就不能再做这个生意了。

en: That being so, even if I must starve to death--and if I starve, this illness will no longer matter--I must make up my mind never to share a bed with a customer again.
u.src: 这么说来，即使要饿死——假如饿死了，这病也就无所谓了——我也一定得下定决定，绝对不能和客人同床了。

en: Otherwise, for the sake of my own safety, I would involve innocent people.
u.src: 不然，就是为了自己的安稳，连累无辜的人。

en: But whatever the case, I am only a woman, easily tempted and deceived.
u.src: 但是无论如何，我只是个女人，很容易被诱惑欺骗。

en: O Christ my Lord in heaven, please protect me, for apart from you I have no one to rely on.
u.src: 天堂的我主基督啊，请求你保佑我，因为除了你之外，我无依无靠。”

en: After Song Jinhua had made up her mind, no matter how Shanchá and Yingchun tried to persuade her, she remained unmoved and firmly refused to receive any more customers.
u.src: 宋金花决定了之后，无论山茶和迎春怎么劝说她，她都无动于衷，坚决不再接客。

en: Sometimes familiar customers came to her room to spend time with her, and she would only sit with them and smoke, but she absolutely would not let them into her bed.
u.src: 偶尔，熟悉的客人来她屋里找她玩耍，她也只是陪客人抽抽烟，但是绝不让客人上自己的床。

en: I have contracted a terrible disease.
u.src: “我得了可怕的病。

en: If you share my bed, you will be infected too.
u.src: 你要是跟我同床的话，也会传染上。”

en: Sometimes, when a client drank too much and tried to make improper advances toward her, Jinhua would refuse him in this way, even showing the client proof that she herself was ill.
u.src: 偶尔客人喝多了酒，想对她做点过分的举动，金花都如此拒绝，甚至给客人自己得病的证据。

en: Gradually, clients stopped coming to see her,
u.src: 慢慢的，客人不再来找她了，

en: and at the same time, her livelihood grew more and more difficult.
u.src: 与此同时，她的生计也越来越窘迫。

en: That night, as usual, she leaned against the table and sat there in a daze for a long time.
u.src: 这天夜晚，她像往常一样靠在桌子前面，长久的呆坐在那里。

en: It seemed that no customers would be coming to her room anymore.
u.src: 看起来并不会有客人来她屋里了。

en: The night grew deeper; except for the chirping of crickets, everything around was as still as water.
u.src: 夜色渐浓，处理蟋蟀的叫声，四周寂静如水。

en: There was no fire lit in the room, and the night was as cool as water,
u.src: 房里没有生火，夜凉如水，

en: the chill from the cold paving stones slowly seeped into her gray satin shoes,
u.src: 从铺地的冰冷石头慢慢侵蚀她灰缎子鞋里，

en: until her slender feet were chilled through.
u.src: 纤细的双脚彻底凉透了。

en: Jinhua stared blankly at the dim oil lamp for a while, lost in thought; then she suddenly shivered, touched the jade earrings on her ears, and fought back a yawn.
u.src: 金花呆呆看着昏暗的油灯，出了一会儿神，懂得一个激灵，她摸了摸耳朵上的翡翠耳环，强忍着没打哈欠。

en: Just then, a strange man suddenly pushed open the painted door and staggered in.
u.src: 恰在此时，一个陌生男人突然推开油漆门，晃晃悠悠的闯了进来。

en: Perhaps he had moved too violently when he came in, for the flame of the oil lamp on the table suddenly leaped with a snap, and black smoke spread through the room with the red fire.
u.src: 可能是他进来的时候动作太大，桌子上的油灯的火苗啪的蹿了一下，黑烟随着赤色火焰在屋内蔓延。

en: The lamplight fell squarely on the visitor. He staggered toward the table as if about to fall, but immediately straightened up, backed away a few steps, and leaned fiercely against the black-lacquered gate he had just closed.
u.src: 灯光刚好打在客人身上，他身体踉跄的向桌子方向倒去，可是有立刻站直了，往后放退了几步，恶狠狠的靠在刚关上的黑漆大门上。

en: Jinhua had no choice but to stand up, staring speechlessly at this foreign guest she had never seen before.
u.src: 金花不得不站了起来，瞠目结舌的看着这个从未见过的外国客人。

en: The guest seemed to be about thirty-five or thirty-six, wearing a brown striped suit and a flat cap of the same cloth; his eyes were large, he had a small mustache, and both cheeks were reddened by the sun.
u.src: 客人大概三十五六岁的样子，穿着茶色条纹西服，头上戴着同样布料的鸭舌帽，眼睛很大，留着小胡子，双颊晒得发红。

en: But one thing truly struck her as strange: although he was certainly a foreigner, it was hard to tell whether he was an Easterner or a Westerner.
u.src: 但是，有一点她实在觉得奇怪，虽谈他肯定是个外国人，但是他到底是东方人还是西方人，却难以分辨。

en: The guest's black hair showed from beneath his cap, and with an extinguished pipe clenched in his mouth he stood blocking the doorway, looking exactly like a drunken passerby who had lost his way.
u.src: 客人的黑色头发从帽子下露出来，嘴里叼着已经熄灭的烟斗，就在房门口堵着，那个样子着实像一个喝多了迷路的过客。

en: May I ask what brings you here?
u.src: “请问你有什么事情吗？”

en: Jinhua was filled with fear and anxiety; she stood straight in front of the table and asked.
u.src: 金花心里有恐惧又害怕，她笔直的站在桌前，问道。

en: The man shook his head to show that he did not understand Chinese; then with one hand he removed the pipe from his mouth and spoke a stretch of incomprehensible foreign language rapidly and fluently.
u.src: 那人摇头示意自己听不懂汉语，随后一手取下叼着的烟斗，语速飞快且流利的说出一段听不懂的外语。

en: Jinhua did not understand and shook her head; the jade earrings on her ears glittered under the light.
u.src: 金花听不懂，摇了摇头，耳朵上的翡翠耳环在灯光下熠熠生辉。

en: The guest looked at Jinhua, who was frowning, and burst out laughing. As he took off his duckbill cap, he staggered toward the table and then dropped heavily into the chair opposite her.
u.src: 客人望着皱着眉头的金花大笑起来，一边脱下鸭舌帽，一边踉踉跄跄的向桌子方向走来，随后重重的坐在对面的椅子上。

en: Only then did Jinhua notice that, although she could not remember when she had ever seen this foreigner before, she felt an inexplicable warmth toward him, as if they had met once before.
u.src: 此时此刻金花才注意到，尽管不记得到底什么时候见过这个外国人，但她对他却有种莫名的亲切感，好像曾经见过一样。

en: The guest casually grabbed some melon seeds from the table, but instead of cracking them open, he kept looking intently at Jinhua. Then, while making a few strange gestures, he began speaking in a foreign language.
u.src: 客人随手抓起桌上的瓜子，却没有嗑，一直认真的看着金花，接着，又边比划一些神奇的手势，边讲起外语。

en: Although Jinhua did not know what he was saying, she vaguely guessed that the guest must know what kind of business she was in.
u.src: 虽然金花不知道他讲的是什么，但是她依稀揣测到，客人应该知道她是做什么生意的。

en: For Jinhua, spending a night with a foreigner she could not communicate with was nothing unusual.
u.src: 对于金花来说，和无法交流的外国人共度一晚稀松平常。

en: So she sat down on a chair, skillfully put on her usual smile, and began telling jokes in Chinese that the other person could not possibly understand.
u.src: 因此，她坐在椅子上，熟练地露出一贯的微笑，开始用汉语讲起来对方不可能听懂的笑话。

en: But after she had said only a word or two, the guest burst out laughing, making it seem as if he could understand.
u.src: 但是她刚说了一两句，客人便哈哈大笑起来，让人觉得他好像能听懂一样。

ja: いつかないほどだった。
en: And his gestures were so varied and lively that they were truly dazzling to watch.
u.src: 并且，他比划的手势丰富多样，着实让人目不暇接。

en: Although the guest reeked strongly of alcohol,
u.src: 虽然客人身上散发出浓重的酒气，

en: his flushed cheeks still showed a man's vitality, brightening even this shabby little room.
u.src: 但是他发红的双颊依然展现出男人的活力，让这个简陋的小屋也明朗起来。

en: In Jinhua's eyes, compared with the Nanjing locals she usually saw and all the Eastern and Western foreigners she had met before,
u.src: 在金花眼里，比起平常见惯的南京土著和之前见过的所有东方西方的外国人来说，

en: this guest was without doubt the most dashing.
u.src: 这位客人无疑是最潇洒的。

en: However, ever since a little while ago, she had felt that she had seen him somewhere before, and that feeling was growing stronger.
u.src: 不过，从刚才开始她就觉得，和他似曾相识，这种感觉愈发强烈。

en: Jinhua looked at the playful black curls on the guest's forehead,
u.src: 金花看着客人额头上俏皮的黑色卷发，
热情的招待他的同时，

en: she was also trying hard to recall the memory of having met him before.
u.src: 还在使劲回忆从前见过他的回忆。

en: Could it be the man who was with the plump lady on the pleasure boat some time ago?
u.src: “难道是前一阵，在画舫上和胖太太在一起的人？

en: No, it was not; that man's hair was even redder.
u.src: 不是的，那个人的头发更加发红。

en: Or perhaps it was the man taking photographs in front of the Confucius Temple at Qinhuai,
u.src: 或者，可能是在秦淮夫子庙前面拍照的人，

en: but that man was much older than the one before her now.
u.src: 但是那人比眼前这位年纪大多了。

en: Or could it have been the man who beat a rickshaw puller with a stick in front of the restaurant by Lishe Bridge,
u.src: 亦或是，在利涉桥边的饭馆前面棒打人力车夫的人，

en: that man did indeed look very much like him,
u.src: 那个人倒是和他非常相像，

en: and at the time there were many people gathered around watching,
u.src: 当时围观的人众多，

en: as he struck the rickshaw puller's back hard with that thick rattan cane...
u.src: 他那这个粗滕杖使劲打人力车夫的背……

en: No, that was not him; that man's eyes were much bluer than this man's.”
u.src: 不是的，那个人的眼珠要比眼前这位蓝得多。”

en: While Jinhua was lost in thought, the foreign guest stayed in high spirits. At some point he had packed fresh tobacco into his pipe, and the smoke drifting through the hut smelled very pleasant.
u.src: 金花沉思的时候，外国客人一直很是快活，不知道什么时候装了新的烟草在烟斗里，烟味飘扬在小屋里，甚是好闻。

en: Suddenly, laughing as he spoke a sentence in a foreign language, he gestured by holding two fingers out in front of Jinhua as if asking a question.
u.src: 突然，他一边笑着说了句外语，一边比划着将两根手指伸到金花面前，做出询问的意思。

en: Everyone knew that two fingers meant two dollars.
u.src: 大家都知道，两根手指是两美元的意思。

ja: ごすことはしなかった。
en: But Jinhua no longer spent the night in bed with customers, so as she cracked melon seeds, she smiled and shook her head twice to show she was unwilling.
u.src: 但是，如今的金花是不跟客人同床过夜的，因此她边嗑瓜子，边微笑的摇了两下头，表示不愿意。

en: The guest propped both elbows on the table, brought his drunken face close to Jinhua, and stared at her in the dim lamplight.
u.src: 客人将双肘支在桌子上，把醉醺醺的脸凑到金花面前，借着昏暗的灯光盯着金花看。

en: After a little while, he held out three fingers and waited for Jinhua's answer.
u.src: 过了一会儿，他又伸出三根手指，期待金花的回答。

en: Jinhua moved the chair slightly backward, still holding melon seeds in her mouth, and showed an embarrassed, troubled expression.
u.src: 金花把椅子稍稍往后挪动了下，嘴里还含着瓜子，露出了为难的表情。

en: She thought to herself that the customer must have misunderstood, assuming she refused to spend the night with him because two dollars was too little.
u.src: 心里暗想，看来客人误会了她是因为两美元太少，所以不愿意跟他过夜。

en: But the two of them did not share a language, so making her understand his predicament was truly difficult.
u.src: 但是两个人语言不通，想要让她明白自己的苦衷，真的很难。

en: Now that things had come to this, Jinhua began to regret how rashly she had taken the initiative,
u.src: 到了如今这个样子，金花开是后悔自己的草率主动，

en: Her bright eyes darted around a few times, and all she could do was shake her head helplessly.
u.src: 她亮晶晶的眼睛转了记下看，只能无可奈何的摇了摇头。

en: The foreign guest still had a smile on his face, but it was clear that he was rather hesitant,
u.src: 外国客人脸上仍然挂着微笑，但也看得出来颇有犹豫，

en: After a while, he held up four fingers again and said a few more words in a foreign language.
u.src: 过了一会儿，他又伸出四根手指，又说了几句外国话。

ja: うことができなくなった。
en: Jinhua helplessly propped her cheek in her hand and could not smile at all anymore,
u.src: 金花无可奈何的托着脸颊，一点也笑不出来了，

ja: めさせるしかなかった。
en: but since things had already come to this, all she could do was keep shaking her head so that he would give up completely.
u.src: 但想到事情已经这样了，自己也只能不停的摇头，让对方彻底死心。

ja: つかんでいるかのように、
en: But it was as if something invisible had seized the guest's hand,
u.src: 但是，好像有什么看不见的东西抓住了客人的手一样，

en: he held out five fingers once again.
u.src: 他再次伸出了五根手指。

en: In this way, the two of them spent a long time communicating with words and gestures.
u.src: 就这样，两个人用了好长时间，连说带比划。

en: The customer was extremely patient, kept adding fingers, and eagerly showed his sincerity, as if even ten dollars would be no problem.
u.src: 客人非常有耐心，不停的增加手指，热切的表现自己的诚意，就算是十美金也没问题。

en: To a prostitute, ten dollars was a huge sum, but Jinhua's attitude remained firm.
u.src: 对于妓女来说，十美金是一笔巨款，但是金花的态度依然坚决。

en: She had already stood up a moment before and was leaning against the edge of the table, irritably stamping her foot and shaking her head.
u.src: 她在刚刚已经站了起来，斜倚在桌子边上，她烦躁的一边跺脚，一边摇头。

en: Just then, for some unknown reason, the cross hanging from the bent hook suddenly fell, made a metallic clatter, and landed on the stone tiles by her feet.
u.src: 恰在此时，不知道为什么，弯钩上挂着的十字架突然掉了下来，发出金属碰撞的声音，落在她脚边的石砖上。

en: Jinhua hurriedly reached out and picked up the cross she treasured like a precious jewel,
u.src: 金花赶忙伸手，捡起视若珍宝的十字架，

en: By chance, she saw the figure of Christ suffering on the cross.
u.src: 无意中，她看见了十字架上受难的基督像。

en: Incredibly, Christ's face was exactly the same as the face of the foreign guest opposite her!
u.src: 难以置信的是，基督的脸和对面外国客人的脸一摸一样！

en: Could it be that I felt he seemed familiar because his face was the face of my Lord Christ?
u.src: “难道我觉得对他似曾相识，原来是我主基督的脸啊。”

en: Jinhua placed the brass cross on her chest, clothed in black satin, and gazed in astonishment at the guest across from her.
u.src: 金花把黄铜十字架放在自己穿着黑缎子杉的胸口上，惊诧的望着对面的客人。

en: The dim lamplight shone on the guest's drunken face,
u.src: 昏暗的灯光照着客人醉醺醺的脸，

en: as he smoked at ease, wearing a smile that lingered in the mind.
u.src: 他自在的抽着烟，面带让人回味的微笑。

en: His eyes kept appraising Jinhua, probably starting from her fair neck,
u.src: 他的眼神不断打量着金花——约莫是从她白皙的脖子，

en: then moving to her ears with jade earrings, looking her over again and again,
u.src: 到带翡翠耳环的耳朵——反复大量，

en: and in Jinhua's eyes, this manner of the guest's unexpectedly took on a kind, gentle dignity.
u.src: 在金花眼里，客人的的这个样子竟然有了一种亲切的温柔的威严。

en: Before long, the guest put down his pipe, tilted his head slightly, and said something in a foreign language with a smile.
u.src: 没过多久，客人放下烟斗，侧了侧脑袋，面带微笑的说了句外语。

en: Those words were like the whisper of a skilled hypnotist murmuring into the ear of someone under his spell,
u.src: 这句话就像是巧妙的催眠师在被催眠者耳畔低声细语，

en: and in Jinhua's heart they stirred up a great wave of suggestion in advance.
u.src: 在金花心里前期巨大的暗示波澜。

en: Jinhua seemed to have completely forgotten her own resolve and gently lowered her Wenxiao-like eyes,
u.src: 金花像是彻底忘了自己的决定一般，温柔的低下了文潇的眼睛，

en: while with one hand she lightly stroked the brass cross, her face full of shy embarrassment as she drew closer to this wondrous foreign guest.
u.src: 手里一边轻抚着黄铜十字架，一边满脸含羞的向这个神奇的外国客人身边靠去。

en: The guest slipped his hand into the pocket of his suit trousers and deliberately made the silver coins inside jingle, his eyes filled with amusement as he gazed with satisfaction at Jinhua's figure.
u.src: 客人把手伸进西裤口袋，把口袋里的银币故意弄得哗哗响，眼里充满了笑意，心满一模的看着金花的身姿。

en: But before long, the laughter in the guest's eyes turned into a scorching flame; he sprang up from his chair and, with both arms wrapped in sleeves soaked with the smell of liquor, fiercely embraced Jinhua.
u.src: 但是，不多一会儿，客人眼里的笑意就变成了炙热的火焰，他猛地从椅子上站了起来，用套在浸满酒气的衣袖里的双臂，狠狠地抱住了金花。

en: Jinhua was utterly dazed and bewitched; her head, adorned with jade earrings, fell weakly backward, a vivid flush rose on her pale face, and through half-closed eyes she stared hazily at the guest's face pressed close before her.
u.src: 金花被迷的七荤八素，戴着翡翠耳环的头无力的向后仰，苍白的脸上显现出鲜艳的血色，她半眯着眼睛，恍惚的看着贴在自己眼前的客人的脸。

en: Should she spend the night with this mysterious foreign guest, or refuse his kisses so that she would not pass her illness on to him?
u.src: 究竟是和这个神奇的外国客人共度一夜，还是为了不传染他疾病而拒绝他的亲吻？

en: Without question, at that moment she had no room at all to think about such a problem.
u.src: 毫无疑问，她这时候根本没空思考这个问题。

en: Jinhua let the bearded guest kiss her passionately, and the joy of tasting love for the first time burned in her breast with the intensity of a raging fire...
u.src: 金花任凭这个满是胡须的客人热情的亲吻自己，第一次品位恋爱的喜悦就像熊熊烈火，激情的燃烧着她的胸口……
